# nuclock_reissue_password (Action)

Mint a new password for a person and **mail it to them**. Their old password stops working at once, every session they hold ends, and the first sign-in must replace the new one. Nothing types the password and nothing echoes it — not this action, not the state, not a log. `password_version` on `nuclock_user` moves.

The key needs the `people.recovery` ability.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# terraform apply -invoke=action.nuclock_reissue_password.ann
# A new password is mailed to Ann; nothing here ever holds it.
action "nuclock_reissue_password" "ann" {
  config {
    user_id = nuclock_user.ann.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) The person — `nuclock_user.<name>.id`.
